import copy,hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib
D=pathlib.Path('/home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/sp01-expression-contract/deliverables/sp01-signing-context-contract-2026-09-10')
def load(n):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(n,D/n);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);return m
B=load('branch-checker-06.py');OLD=load('branch-checker-05.py');F=load('branch-checker-06.test.py');C=B.C
base=json.loads((D/'exact-branch-history-05.json').read_text());rows=[]
def ctx(g):return {'base':{'network':'local','deployment':'d1','revoked':False,'consumed':set(),'consumedOccurrences':set()},'consumedOutputs':set(),'compositionAuthorityHash':B.digest('composition-authority',g['compositionAuthorization'])}
def run(name,g,x,expect,old=None):
 before=copy.deepcopy((g,x));r=B.validate(g,x);actual=r.get('firstPredicate',r['status']);assert actual==expect,(name,r,expect);assert (g,x)==before,name+' mutated input';assert not r['signatureVerified'] and not r['ledgerAccepted'];row={'check':name,'result':actual}
 if old is not None:
  o=OLD.validate(g,x);oa=o.get('firstPredicate',o['status']);assert oa==old,(name,oa,old);row['version05Result']=oa
 rows.append(row)
def empty(g):
 g['nodes']=[];g['current']=[{'node':B.digest('root',g['seed']),'output':'0'}];return g
run('exact fixture positive',base,ctx(base),'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
x=ctx(base);x['base']['consumed'].add(base['seed']['steps'][-1]['stateHash']);run('consumed seed head',base,x,'SEED_CURRENTNESS','SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
g=copy.deepcopy(base);g['nodes'][0]['outputs'][0]['state']['balances']['alice.A']='99';F.reseal(g);run('consumed seed before false graph output',g,x,'SEED_CURRENTNESS','OUTPUT_RELATION')
x=ctx(base);x['consumedOutputs'].add(B.refkey(base['current'][0]));run('consumed final output',base,x,'CURRENTNESS','SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
g=empty(copy.deepcopy(base));x=ctx(g);run('empty graph control',g,x,'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID');x['consumedOutputs'].add(B.refkey(g['current'][0]));run('empty graph consumed root',g,x,'CURRENTNESS','SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
g=copy.deepcopy(base);g['nodes']=g['nodes'][:2];g['current']=sorted([{'node':g['nodes'][0]['id'],'output':'1'},{'node':g['nodes'][1]['id'],'output':'0'}],key=lambda r:(r['node'],int(r['output'])));x=ctx(g);run('untouched sibling control',g,x,'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID');x['consumedOutputs'].add((g['nodes'][0]['id'],'1'));run('consumed untouched sibling',g,x,'CURRENTNESS','SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID');g['current']=[r for r in g['current'] if B.refkey(r) not in x['consumedOutputs']];run('omitted consumed sibling still rejects',g,x,'CURRENTNESS','CURRENT_OUTPUTS');run('omitted available sibling',g,ctx(g),'CURRENT_OUTPUTS')
g=empty(copy.deepcopy(base));g['seed']['steps']=[];g['current'][0]['node']=B.digest('root',g['seed']);x=ctx(g);run('zero-step seed control',g,x,'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID');x['base']['consumed'].add(g['seed']['initialHash']);run('zero-step consumed seed head',g,x,'SEED_CURRENTNESS','SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID');x=ctx(g);x['consumedOutputs'].add(B.refkey(g['current'][0]));run('zero-step consumed graph root',g,x,'CURRENTNESS','SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
x=ctx(base);x['consumedOutputs'].add((B.digest('root',base['seed']),'0'));run('selected root consumed',base,x,'CURRENTNESS','CURRENTNESS')
x=ctx(base);x['base']['consumed'].add(base['seed']['initialHash']);run('linear predecessor consumed',base,x,'SEED_CURRENTNESS','SEED_CURRENTNESS')
x=ctx(base);x['base']['consumed'].add('f'*64);x['consumedOutputs'].update({('e'*64,'0'),(base['current'][0]['node'],'7'),(B.digest('root',base['seed']),'1')});run('unrelated identities and wrong output indexes',base,x,'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
for name,mut,expected in [('bad outer context',lambda x:x.update(extra=1),'CONTEXT_SHAPE'),('list consumedOutputs',lambda x:x.update(consumedOutputs=[]),'CONTEXT_SHAPE'),('list base consumed',lambda x:x['base'].update(consumed=[]),'SEED_CONTEXT_SHAPE'),('revoked seed',lambda x:x['base'].update(revoked=True),'SEED_REVOKED')]:
 x=ctx(base);mut(x);run(name,base,x,expected)
g=copy.deepcopy(base);g['extra']=1;x=ctx(base);x['base']['consumed'].add(base['seed']['steps'][-1]['stateHash']);run('graph schema precedes currentness',g,x,'GRAPH_SCHEMA')
g=copy.deepcopy(base);g['extra']='x'*(B.PROFILE['maxBytes']+1);run('bound precedes schema and currentness',g,x,'GRAPH_BOUND')
g=copy.deepcopy(base);g['nodes'][0]['id']='f'*64;run('import currentness precedes node hash',g,x,'SEED_CURRENTNESS');run('available seed exposes node hash',g,ctx(g),'NODE_HASH')
for field,value in [('predecessorStateHash','e'*64),('predecessorLocation','graph:0:1'),('predecessorResourceHash','d'*64),('planHash','c'*64),('postStateHash','b'*64),('terminal',True)]:
 g=copy.deepcopy(base);a=g['seed']['authority'];a['exactOccurrences'][1][field]=value;F.F.rehash(g['seed']);g['compositionAuthorization']['originHash']=g['seed']['authorityHash'];g['nodes'][0]['predecessors'][0]['node']=B.digest('root',g['seed']);
 for n in g['nodes']:n['origin']=g['seed']['authorityHash']
 F.reseal(g);run('graph occurrence binds '+field,g,ctx(g),'EXACT_OCCURRENCE_BINDING')
x=ctx(base);x['base']['consumedOccurrences'].add(base['nodes'][1]['occurrenceId']);run('externally consumed occurrence',base,x,'EXACT_OCCURRENCE_CONSUMED')
# Additional lifecycle and residual-duty boundary controls.
g=F.fixture();g['seed']=F.F.cancel(g['seed']);g['compositionAuthorization']['originHash']=g['seed']['authorityHash'];empty(g);x=ctx(g);run('cancelled seed with duty2 empty graph control',g,x,'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID');assert g['seed']['steps'][-1]['post']['duties'][0]['amount']=='2';x['consumedOutputs'].add(B.refkey(g['current'][0]));run('consumed root carrying duty2',g,x,'CURRENTNESS');g['current']=[];run('omitting consumed duty2 root cannot erase it',g,x,'CURRENTNESS')
g=F.fixture();g['nodes'][1]['body']={'action':'accrue','arguments':[{'name':'loan','type':'ObligationId','value':'Loan01'},{'name':'interest','type':'UInt128','value':'2'}],'operations':[{'op':'Accrue','obligation':'Loan01','amount':{'literal':'2'}}],'sidecarHex':''};F.reseal(g);run('branch accrual before debt creation',g,ctx(g),'DEBT_NOT_CREATED')
g=F.fixture();g['seed']['authority']['netGoal']='18';g['seed']['steps'][0]['terminal']=True;F.F.rehash(g['seed']);g['compositionAuthorization']['originHash']=g['seed']['authorityHash'];run('terminal seed blocks graph continuation',g,ctx(g),'TERMINAL_CONTINUATION');empty(g);run('terminal seed permits empty graph',g,ctx(g),'SOURCE_GRAPH_VALID')
# Schema/profile consistency and independently reconstructed SHA preimages.
def digest(domain,kind,obj):return hashlib.sha256((domain+'/'+kind).encode()+b'\0'+json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
schema=json.loads((D/'schema-05.json').read_text());bs=json.loads((D/'branch-schema-05.json').read_text());assert C.schema_for(C.PROFILE)==schema;assert bs['properties']['seed']==schema;assert B.PROFILE==json.loads((D/'branch-profile-05.json').read_text());assert base['profileHash']==digest('MORIARTY-SIGNING-BRANCH-EXAMPLE/5','profile',{'parameters':B.PROFILE,'schema':bs})
for n in base['nodes']:assert n['id']==digest('MORIARTY-SIGNING-BRANCH-EXAMPLE/5','node',{k:v for k,v in n.items() if k!='id'})
assert base['seed']['authorityHash']==digest('MORIARTY-SIGNING-CONTEXT-EXAMPLE/5','authority',base['seed']['authority'])
print(json.dumps({'independentChecks':rows,'checkCount':len(rows),'profileSchemaCommitments':'PASS','inputMutation':'none'},indent=2));pathlib.Path('/tmp/signing-independent-06-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
